title: bay erlang b
summary: A no-wait decontamination station receives vehicles as a Poisson process at 5 per hour. Each occupied bay has exponential service time with mean 2 hours. If every bay is occupied, an arriving vehicle is diverted immediately and never queues. The station requires the long-run diversion probability to be below 1%. The team must choose the smallest integer number of identical bays under this loss-system model.
